mapper.select: SELECT account_id, default_account_id, trading_default_order_type, trading_skip_order_confirmation, trading_default_trade_quantity, notifications_trade_fills, notifications_price_alerts, display_theme, display_base_currency, updated_at FROM tradingsystem.customer_preferences WHERE account_id = #{accountId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tradingsystem.customer_preferences ( account_id, default_account_id, trading_default_order_type, trading_skip_order_confirmation, trading_default_trade_quantity, notifications_trade_fills, notifications_price_alerts, display_theme, display_base_currency, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{defaultAccountId}, #{tradingDefaultOrderType}, #{tradingSkipOrderConfirmation}, #{tradingDefaultTradeQuantity}, #{notificationsTradeFills, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{notificationsPriceAlerts, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{displayTheme}, #{displayBaseCurrency}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET default_account_id = EXCLUDED.default_account_id, trading_default_order_type = EXCLUDED.trading_default_order_type, trading_skip_order_confirmation = EXCLUDED.trading_skip_order_confirmation, trading_default_trade_quantity = EXCLUDED.trading_default_trade_quantity, notifications_trade_fills = EXCLUDED.notifications_trade_fills, notifications_price_alerts = EXCLUDED.notifications_price_alerts, display_theme = EXCLUDED.display_theme, display_base_currency = EXCLUDED.display_base_currency, updated_at = NOW();
